profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Front-End at Two Six Technologies | M.S. Computer Science Georgia Tech University
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with an active TS/SCI clearance, currently at Two Six Technologies. I specialize in full-stack development across TypeScript, Java, and C#, with hands-on experience building and scaling complex applications from the Linux kernel level up through modern frontend frameworks including Angular, AngularJS, Next.js, and Ember.js.
On the backend, I work with PostgreSQL, Fastify, and Docker, and I'm well-versed in secure development practices — including static analysis with Fortify and API testing with Postman. I've collaborated across teams to deliver mission-critical software, leveraging tools like Git, Jenkins, Confluence, and Jira throughout the full development lifecycle.
I hold a CompTIA Security+ certification along with several other industry-standard credentials, reflecting my commitment to both engineering excellence and security-conscious development

positions.title: Project Delivery Specialist Sr Consultant
positions.description:
Responsible for maintaining and enhancing Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) tools built on Cognos TM1 (IBM Planning Analytics). 

Produced a financial system for a federal client that had a major upgrade using a front-end and back-end development as well as transferring classified information from high-side to low-side for remote development. 

Involved in development of TM1 architecture (Backend Database), processes and applications for new functionality requirements. 

Optimized User-Interface (UI) front-end screens that have provided for client upgrades for a complete restructure of their legacy system using Angular, AngularJS, RXJS, HTML, and CSS. Daily handling of bug fixes working with the functional team to enhance the user’s performance. Work with certain individuals to correct database changes using SQL Developer. 

Responsible for developing and maintaining lowside backend implementation using typescript, Docker, Postman, MongoDB, and Fastify. Full-Stack Developer Experience.
